# GENERATED FILE, DO NOT EDIT BY HAND.
# Built from the game files of CK3 fixture by tools/generate_building_effects.ps1.
# Run the script again after a game update to pick up new buildings.

# Priority used by mqa_b_priority_fill_province_effect (yields at maximum level,
# before culture, terrain and holding bonuses):
#   rank  building                levies  gold/month
#      1  barracks                    25        0.00
#      2  farms                        0        1.25
#   never built, replaced first: unused

# Province scope, scope:holder must be the holder of the barony.
# Upgrades every existing building straight to the highest level whose own
# requirements are met, as when building it by hand, holding main buildings first
# (other buildings need their level).
mqa_b_upgrade_province_buildings_effect = {
	if = {
		limit = {
			OR = {
				has_building = castle_01
			}
			scope:holder = { is_landed = yes }
		}
		add_building = castle_02
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			OR = {
				has_building = barracks_01
			}
			holding_type = castle_holding
			development_level >= 5
		}
		add_building = barracks_02
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			OR = {
				has_building = farms_01
			}
			always = yes
		}
		add_building = farms_02
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			OR = {
				has_building = special_01
			}
			always = yes
		}
		replace_building_effect = special_02
	}
}

# Province scope. Remove a regular building, whatever its level.
mqa_b_remove_barracks_effect = {
	if = {
		limit = { has_building = barracks_01 }
		remove_building = barracks_01
	}
	if = {
		limit = { has_building = barracks_02 }
		remove_building = barracks_02
	}
}
mqa_b_remove_farms_effect = {
	if = {
		limit = { has_building = farms_01 }
		remove_building = farms_01
	}
	if = {
		limit = { has_building = farms_02 }
		remove_building = farms_02
	}
}
mqa_b_remove_unused_effect = {
	if = {
		limit = { has_building = unused_01 }
		remove_building = unused_01
	}
}

# Province scope, scope:holder must be the holder of the barony.
# Goes down the priority list. Each missing building the holder could build here
# by hand (all of its first level's requirements, copied from the game) is built
# in a free slot, straight at the highest level whose requirements are met; when no
# slot is free, the worst-ranked building below it is removed to make room. No slot
# is ever added.
mqa_b_priority_fill_province_effect = {
	if = {
		limit = {
			NOT = { has_building_or_higher = barracks_01 }
			holding_type = castle_holding
			scope:holder = { has_innovation = innovation_crop_rotation }
		}
		if = {
			limit = { free_building_slots < 1 }
			if = {
				limit = { has_building_or_higher = unused_01 }
				mqa_b_remove_unused_effect = yes
			}
			else_if = {
				limit = { has_building_or_higher = farms_01 }
				mqa_b_remove_farms_effect = yes
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = { free_building_slots > 0 }
			if = {
				limit = {
					holding_type = castle_holding
					development_level >= 5
				}
				add_building = barracks_02
			}
			else = {
				add_building = barracks_01
			}
		}
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			NOT = { has_building_or_higher = farms_01 }
			always = yes
		}
		if = {
			limit = { free_building_slots < 1 }
			if = {
				limit = { has_building_or_higher = unused_01 }
				mqa_b_remove_unused_effect = yes
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = { free_building_slots > 0 }
			if = {
				limit = {
					always = yes
				}
				add_building = farms_02
			}
			else = {
				add_building = farms_01
			}
		}
	}
}

# Character scope (the domicile owner). Cancels the domicile's ongoing construction, with
# the game's own refund, so that its slot can be filled and upgraded right away.
mqa_b_cancel_domicile_construction_effect = {
	if = {
		limit = { domicile ?= { has_ongoing_domicile_construction = yes } }
		domicile = {
			if = {
				limit = { has_domicile_construction = army_01 }
				remove_domicile_building = army_01
			}
			if = {
				limit = { has_domicile_construction = army_02 }
				remove_domicile_building = army_02
			}
			if = {
				limit = { has_domicile_construction = base_01 }
				remove_domicile_building = base_01
			}
			if = {
				limit = { has_domicile_construction = base_02 }
				remove_domicile_building = base_02
			}
			if = {
				limit = { has_domicile_construction = gold_01 }
				remove_domicile_building = gold_01
			}
			if = {
				limit = { has_domicile_construction = internal_01 }
				remove_domicile_building = internal_01
			}
		}
	}
}

# Character scope (the domicile owner). Builds missing buildings in free slots, by priority:
# buildings with army bonuses first, then gold and resources, then the rest. External
# buildings go in the domicile's external slots, internal ones in the internal slots of their
# parent building. Each building is only attempted when the character meets its own
# can_construct, copied from the game.
mqa_b_construct_domicile_effect = {
	if = {
		limit = { domicile ?= { is_domicile_type = camp } }
		if = {
			limit = {
				domicile ?= {
					free_external_domicile_building_slots >= 1
					NOT = { has_domicile_building_or_higher = base_01 }
				}
			}
			domicile = { add_domicile_building = base_01 }
		}
	}
	if = {
		limit = { domicile ?= { is_domicile_type = estate } }
		if = {
			limit = {
				domicile ?= {
					free_external_domicile_building_slots >= 1
					NOT = { has_domicile_building_or_higher = base_01 }
				}
			}
			domicile = { add_domicile_building = base_01 }
		}
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			domicile ?= {
				has_domicile_building_or_higher = army_01
				domicile_building_has_free_internal_slot = army_01
				NOT = { has_domicile_building_or_higher = internal_01 }
			}
		}
		domicile = { add_domicile_building = internal_01 }
	}
}

# Character scope (the domicile owner). Upgrades every domicile building one level at a
# time, main building first, when the character meets the next level's can_construct.
# Where a building can specialize, the best allowed specialization is picked by the same
# priority, then upgraded in turn.
mqa_b_upgrade_domicile_effect = {
	if = {
		limit = {
			domicile ?= {
				has_domicile_building = base_01
			}
			always = yes
		}
		domicile = { add_domicile_building = base_02 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			domicile ?= {
				has_domicile_building = base_02
			}
			is_landed = yes
		}
		domicile = { add_domicile_building = army_01 }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = {
			domicile ?= {
				has_domicile_building = base_02
			}
		}
		domicile = { add_domicile_building = gold_01 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			domicile ?= {
				has_domicile_building = army_01
			}
			is_adult = yes
		}
		domicile = { add_domicile_building = army_02 }
	}
}
